issue.title: Add the Day Strip glossary term (alias: day stats)

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by bob-cli-bp.2 note #2, bob-cli-bp.3 note #1, bob-cli-bp.4 note #2, bob-cli-bp.5 note #2, and bob-cli-bp.6 note #2 (epic bob-cli-bp, plan plan:202610/daily_note_day_strip.md). Add a glossary strand `glossary:day-strip` (alias: day stats) with `/sase_memory_write`: the read-only daily-stats receipt that bob-ledger-tools renders after the last line of every canonical daily note (`YYYY/YYYYMMDD.md`) in Live Preview, or wherever a `bob-day-stats` fence embeds it. It shows that note's own day only (Worked, Reviewed, Done, Created, Review closed tiles with eight history marks, plus the area time mix), reads every value from `bob stats`, and is never written into the note. Distinguish it from the Morning GTD Review Footer (the status-bar review item): "footer" names that, so this is the Day strip in code and docs and "Day stats" in UI copy and the `Toggle Day stats` command. Link [[morning-gtd-review-footer]] and [[pomodoro]], and the Day strip decision record (bob-cli-bs) once it lands. Source: bob-cli docs/stats.md#day-strip (41afa14b).

The epic selected glossary_term=no automatically (planner default, no human review), not by human rejection; no memory was changed during the epic or its landing. Run sase memory init only when implementing with appropriate authorization.

issue.creation_reason: Every bob-cli-bp phase proposed this term after the epic's auto-decision skipped it; the Day strip is now a user-facing surface whose name collides with the Morning GTD Review Footer.

payload.description: Glossary half of the same skipped Day strip memory follow-ups
